answer: Gene-editing teams hunt unintended edits by looking at sites the guide was never aimed at, since side effects reveal the tool. Sybil hunting can do similar: look beyond the target behaviour at incidental traces, like shared nonce habits or identical idle gaps. A walnut-brown honest account carries its own noise, while clones climbing one trellis leave matching footprints, and each ripple of identical timing merges them into one entity.
